children: Cogent Biosciences entered into a Commercial Supply Agreement with Hovione to manufacture bezuclastinib spray-dried dispersion and tablets. The pact uses rolling quarterly forecasts with a binding near-term portion and requires Cogent to purchase minimum, declining percentages of its product needs from Hovione. The initial term is five years with automatic two-year renewals, and either party may opt out before renewals or terminate for specified events including breach, prolonged force majeure, insolvency, or regulatory developments. The agreement is intended to secure commercial-scale supply ahead of potential market needs.
